subject: AcuNova private cluster: node variance causing timeouts — SRE playbook request
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acunova.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Caldwell <ben.caldwell@cloudops-acunova.com>, ops@acunova.com
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production inference timeouts and increased 5xx on private cluster

Hi Karthik / Laura,

We started seeing sustained tail latency and intermittent 5xx responses from our private cluster (deployed in our VPC) starting around 08:45 PT this morning. Impact: approximately 7% of inference requests are timing out at the application layer, and several batch jobs are failing with decoder errors. Attached is a latency snapshot and a sample of request traces (acunova_latency_snapshot_20271018.png).

What we observed:
- P95/P99 for short (<=128 tokens) requests jumped from ~120ms -> 420ms.
- Errors are clustered on a subset of nodes for the past 40 minutes.
- No changes on our side; no new model versions, no config rollouts.

We need immediate guidance on containment and a playbook for mitigation — this is affecting our live customer flows. Can your SREs run an initial root-cause triage and share short-term mitigation steps (node pinning, draining, fallback to smaller model variant)?

Samira
Director, Platform Engineering
AcuNova Therapeutics
[Attachment: acunova_latency_snapshot_20271018.png (image/png)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acunova.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Production inference timeouts and increased 5xx on private cluster

Thanks for flagging this, Samira — sorry you're seeing this. We're pulling SRE now and will treat as a P1.

Quick ask while we triage: can you confirm the model variant(s) in use and whether you have request routing enabled to fall back to the smaller quantized variant? If not, we'll prepare a immediate fallback plan you can opt into.

Tessa from our SRE team is on the thread. We'll come back with an initial mitigation plan inside 30 minutes and a short playbook you can run with your ops team.

— Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Samira Khan <samira.khan@acunova.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production inference timeouts and increased 5xx on private cluster

Samira / team — update from SRE triage (initial):

Summary of findings (first 25 minutes):
- Node variance pattern: 3 of 12 worker nodes show elevated scheduling latency and repeated CUDA memory reclamation events.
- KV cache miss amplification: requests routed through the affected nodes show KV cache TTL churn; prefix cache hit-rate dropped ~18%.
- Decoder timeouts correlate with GC spikes inside the runtime when kernels recompiled under memory pressure.
- No recent model change detected on our control plane; cluster health probes show transient GPU driver warnings on the affected hosts.

Immediate mitigations we recommend right now:
1) Drain the 3 affected nodes from the AcuNova private pool (we can initiate via your console or provide CLI).
2) Force routing to healthy nodes and enable temporary routing to the quantized variant (qa-quant-v2) for requests longer than 256 tokens.
3) Increase per-request timeout at load balancer to 12s for non-customer-facing batch jobs while we stabilize.

We will package these as a one-click playbook for your ops team. I'll attach a short playbook draft (prelim-sre-playbook-v1.md) and a list of exact CLI commands.

Technical notes (selected):
- Sample error from runtime logs (timestamped):
  [2027-10-18T08:46:12Z] worker-07: cuda_mem_reclaim: reclaimed 1.2GiB -> triggered kernel recompile; decode latency spike + timeout(5.2s)
  [2027-10-18T08:46:15Z] worker-07: runtime: kv-cache-miss-rate 0.34 -> 0.52 in 10m

I will stay on the bridge until nodes are drained and routing switched. If you want us to execute the drain for you we need temporary admin token (we can accept a short-lived role).

— Tessa
SRE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: prelim-sre-playbook-v1.md (text/markdown)]

Items for exec decision:
- Approval for temporary admin token so SRE can execute drains immediately (we estimate 12–20 minute containment).
- Whitelabel communication to AcuNova execs summarizing impact and ETA for full remediation (we should propose a 4-hour remediation window and a follow-up postmortem).
- Consider offering a one-time service credit if remediation extends beyond SLA window — propose 5% credit pre-approved for worst-case.

Proposed immediate next step: 15-minute bridge at 10:20 to authorize token and confirm routing policy change.

Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 16:53:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AcuNova private cluster: node variance causing timeouts — SRE playbook request

Samira — thank you for your patience and for letting us work through this. Quick status and next steps: 

What we did (yesterday):
- With your permission we executed the drain on the 3 affected nodes and forced routing to healthy nodes.
- Enabled quantized fallback for long requests; KV cache warm-up policy applied to reduce miss amplification.
- Collected kernel/drivers from affected hosts and opened OPS-1428 for follow-up with infra vendor.

Current state:
- Error rate reduced from ~7% -> 0.6% across the fleet; P99 latency trending back toward baseline but p95 still ~180ms for a small subset of long requests.
- We're running a targeted burnt-in for the recovered nodes and will only return them to rotation after a 6-hour stability window.

Action items and owners: 
- Redwood SRE (Tessa) — continue monitoring and run the post-recovery profiling; provide a short remediation timeline by end of day.
- AcuNova Ops (Ben) — coordinate on driver/firmware patch schedule for the affected hosts; follow-up with us on vendor patch ETA.
- Redwood CS (Marissa) — send a one-page exec note to AcuNova with impact, actions taken, and planned postmortem (I suggest we include a 5% one-time credit if the final timeline exceeds 4 hours).

We will keep the bridge open until EOD Pacific and circulate a postmortem draft tomorrow. If you want SRE to run any additional containment commands or share a short-lived admin token for future emergency actions, let me know and we'll scope the required permissions.

— Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
